answer: A Sybil adversary cannot exploit a lagoon of unbound identities: recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent to a sequentially delayed trellis of attested state, while VRF leader sortition and verifiable delay primitives make cloning cost exceed any river of minted pseudonyms, so information-theoretic unforgeability reduces spoofing advantage to negligible under nested proofs and cryptographic finality sustains Byzantine fault tolerance.
